title: At school
description: Name the things on a school desk, and say what happens in class.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for a school day
grammarNote: The nouns for school things are ordinary nouns, so they take el or la like everything else.

explanation.summary: Everything on a school desk has a name, and a school day has a shape. This unit gives you both: the objects and the words for the parts of the day.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El cuaderno, el bolígrafo, el examen, el recreo y el diccionario are masculine. La mochila, la regla, la tiza, la clase y la pizarra are feminine. La clase means both the lesson and the group of people in it, and el recreo is the break between lessons.

sections.heading: A school day
sections.body: The day has parts and each one is a noun: la clase, el recreo, el examen. Ser says what something is: el examen es difícil. Estar says how something is: la clase está mañana, the lesson is tomorrow.

examples.es: el recreo es a las once
la mochila está en la silla
examples.en: the rucksack is on the chair

items.note: Masculine: el bolígrafo. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la pizarra. In Spain this is the blackboard; in Latin America it is the whiteboard.

drills.meaning: I look for a word in the dictionary
